errors.text: The hypothesis replaces the simulated FeNiCrCoCu/Cu nanoindentation-friction system with an unspecified macroscopic dry-sliding test in air.
It makes protective oxide-film formation the dominant mechanism even though oxidation is absent from the target model and no evidence is cited to support that assumption.
It predicts an initial improvement in wear with temperature, whereas the target indicates approximately stable hardness and wear resistance through 600 K, followed by sharp degradation near 900 K.
It does not propose the target's quantitative degradation boundary of approximately 900 K.
